newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia Yield Spreads - Underperform post-budget.
newsitem.headline: Australia Yield Spreads - Underperform post-budget.

text.p: Australian bonds underperformed against the dollar bloc in the wake of Tuesday's 1997/98 Federal budget and in anticipation of further jitters in U.S. Treasuries ahead of next week's Federal Open Market Committee meeting.

Bill Evans, General Manager Economics at Westpac Banking Corp, said that while the budget impact on domestic bonds is positive in the medium, it is a short-term negative due to disappointment at the size of the 1997/98 underlying deficit and the lack of new policy savings.
He also expects the Australia/U.S. 10-year to widen to 120 basis points on resumed Fed tightening concerns.
U.S. Treasuries eased on Tuesday, despite a weak outcome to April retail sales, amid uncertainty ahead of the May 20 policy meeting.
Canadian debt also weakened on Tuesday, but outperformed the U.S., while New Zealand bonds were stable despite a softer N.Z. TWI.
